# Ember Review Templates

These files are Ember-defined review contracts; GitHub does not auto-discover
them. Select the template matching the dominant risk. Every review records its
template marker, reviewer identity, exact reviewed head, evidence reproduced,
findings by priority, and verdict. Any later commit invalidates the verdict.

Unresolved P0/P1 findings block merge. A review label is metadata, not evidence;
the exact-head review comment or content-addressed artifact is authoritative.
